features.title: Store a settled attempt's replay metadata once
features.summary: Owned fork of the native agent loop. A settled assistant message carries the provider's replay envelope on its message source; the same envelope's per-block list was also written into the durable compact stream, so every assistant message kept its block signatures twice. This fork stores the stream copy without the block list, leaving the response-level envelope and the message source untouched. Everything else is the pinned upstream code.

configuration.constraints: Restated from the stock row because a patch replaces whole configs.

failureModes: A consumer that reads per-block replay metadata from the durable stream instead of the message source sees only the response-level envelope. The browser already receives neither copy, and the provider replay path reads the message source — asserted by tests/agent-loop.integration.test.ts.
Every other behaviour is the pinned upstream code; drift is checked with scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs.

verification.testName: a settled message stores the response envelope once
stores the replay envelope once and still replays it to the provider

verification.reason: Host-only fork with no surface of its own: it changes what one durable event stores, and the Session conversation that would show it belongs to the chat plugin.

telemetry.reason: The model stream already opens the native `llm request` span; this fork only changes what one durable event stores.

features.title: Stop a runaway tool call
features.summary: A model that keeps streaming one tool call's arguments past a size or time bound (2026-11-11: an apply_patch call streamed 199 KB of whitespace for 15 minutes until the provider dropped the connection and the step failed) is stopped at the stream read. The provider request is aborted, the cut call is recorded with empty arguments and never runs, and its error result tells the model to resend smaller calls. The turn continues with the next step.

configuration.constraints: Integer bytes, at least 1; read at each model attempt.
Integer milliseconds from the call's first argument chunk, at least 1; read at each model attempt. A stream that goes silent is the adapter idle watchdog's job, not this bound.

failureModes: A legitimate call larger than the byte bound, or slower than the time bound, is cut too; the result names both settings so the user can raise them.
Other tool calls still open in the same reply are cut with it and told to resend on their own; calls that already finished run normally.

verification.testName: stops a call whose arguments outgrow the byte limit, runs nothing, and tells the model how to retry

verification.reason: Host-only: the cut call shows as an ordinary failed tool card in the chat plugin, whose rendering this fork does not change.

telemetry.reason: The cut happens inside the native `llm request` span of the attempt it stops, and the cut call is recorded as an ordinary tool/call and tool/result pair.
